description: This file declares configuration functions for Honda Accord and Civic engine tuning parameters, serving as a header file with function prototypes and include guards.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationTwoWires
methods.description: Sets engine configuration for Honda Accord with two wires, parameterized by DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationThreeWires
methods.description: Sets engine configuration for Honda Accord with three wires, parameterized by DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfigurationDip
methods.description: Sets a specific dip configuration for Honda Accord engine, parameterized by DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24
methods.description: Sets a specific configuration variant (possibly for 1.24L) for Honda Accord engine.

methods.name: setHondaAccordConfiguration1_24_shifted
methods.description: Set a shifted version of the 1.24 configuration for Honda Accord.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_both
methods.description: Configure Honda Civic with 4.0 engine parameters, both configurations.

methods.name: setHondaCivic4_0_rise
methods.description: Configure Honda Civic 4.0 engine parameters with a 'rise' configuration.
